marketing_description: The DeWALT DCF809D1 Atomic Compact Series Cordless Compact Impact Driver Kit features a 20 V Lithium-Ion battery, 2 Ah capacity, and a variable speed trigger for pro-level control. With a torque rating of 1700 in-lb and 0 to 3200 impacts per minute, this kit is suitable for a variety of applications. The kit includes a 1/4 in hex drive and a LED light for improved visibility in dark workspaces.
